context: The stall watch flagged merge.py as stuck on Oct 26 while it was working. Its output went to a log file, so the screen stayed quiet past 300 seconds. The recorded decision says the watcher never changes; quiet tools print a line every 120 seconds instead. PR #598 is built, red-first, reviewed and green.

options.gain: Every command that logs to a file stops raising false alarms, with no change to each tool.
options.how: The watcher also checks whether a log file the command names is growing (one file check a second).
options.label: Merge #598 and rewrite the decision
options.lose: A file that something else writes could hide a real stall. Claude is unlikely to cause that by mistake.

options.how: merge.py already prints 'merge: waiting on ...'; the Mac merge hand now runs it without the redirect.
options.label: Keep the decision and close #598
options.lose: Each tool that logs to a file needs its own fix; until then it cries wolf.

ref: c60 (the stall watch does not cry wolf), PR #598
title: Stop the stall watch's false alarm on a command that writes to its own log
why: Sending output to a log is a normal way to run a long job; fixing one tool at a time leaves the alarm crying wolf elsewhere.
